english.title: Driver of a London PHV fail to wear badge plainly visible - London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which a London private hire vehicle licence related, when using that vehicle as a private hire vehicle on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD..), failed to wear the badge issued to you in such a position and manner as to be plainly and distinctly visible
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(3) and (5) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

english.notes: Section 14(4) provides that the Secretary of State may by notice exempt a person from the requirement relating to this offence when he is the driver of a vehicle being used to provide a service specified in the notice if he considers it inappropriate (having regard to that service) to require the badge to be worn.
